articleTitle: Comparison of Non-Isolated Boost Converter & Isolated Flyback Converter for PV Application
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Need of alternate electrical energy resources and compatibility with grid connection has revived the interest in PV system. In this paper, PV module is designed. The different characteristics curve of solar cell is obtained and it's dependency is observed on temperature and irradiation. The non-isolated boost and isolated flyback converter is used as an interface between PV panel and the load. A detailed analysis and operation of flyback converter and boost converter has been discussed. Perturb and Observe Maximum power point tracking algorithm has been employed to operate the panel voltage at its MPP. For design of controller, state space analysis is also done to get transfer function of PV voltage and duty ratio The performance of both converter is compared in this paper.

articleTitle: Change Detection from Pre and PostUrbanisation LANDSAT 5TM Multispectral Images
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Change detection (CD) from the Earth surface is a very attractive topic of research for the researchers contributing to the field of Earth observation and remote sensing. Texture classification from remotely sensed images is among one of the techniques to monitor these changes in a detailed manner. Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) method for texture classification from remotely sensed satellite images provides us information about the second order statistics of the image in a detailed manner. It evaluates texture features (TF) of the image in terms of contrast, correlation, energy and homogeneity. These features not only predict the changing behaviour of the texture but also quantify these changes. This research examines the competence of post classification GLCM technique in the field of texture based change detection. Changing condition are analysed on the basis of pre and post-urbanisation Landsat 5TM images of Las Vegas (LV) for a period of around 25 years. Finally, the changing behaviour of the texture predicts the change of the Land-Cover (LC) in this period of time.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Efficient 6-T SRAM Cell with Performance Measurements
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Among all the semiconductor memory modules available today, SRAM is considered to be the most critical and highly demanding semiconductor memory in the gamut of microelectronics applications as it does not require the need of regular refreshing. As the technology is continuously scaling down, it results in reduction of feature size along with the miniaturization at chip level. But along with this, the need of low power devices has also increased. But the genuine dilemma, especially for SRAM, is the leakage power. To solve leakage power problems, a large number of power reduction techniques are used. There are various advantages of using low power devices for example, the use of low power makes the device more portable with easy handling, improved battery life along with great improvement in the performance parameters. In processing as well as in memories and in data handling applications, devices with low power dissipation are in great demand. In this paper, the comparative study of various leakage power reduction techniques like Schmitt trigger, forced stack technique and LECTOR technique with SRAM architecture has been done. Simulation and analysis results show that the SRAM cell using forced stack technique attains lowest static power dissipation and total power dissipation along with all the advantages of the existing SRAM Cell. The simulation is done on the Symica DE and LT spice with 45 nm PTM technology.

articleTitle: Foggy Image Enhancement and Object Identification by Extended Maxima Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Clear vision is very important while driving regardless of any environmental conditions or mechanical challenges. To overcome the difficult conditions and external challenges of human vision while driving a vehicle, image processing techniques can be used. This paper mainly deals with the difficult conditions like poor lighting in the roads, difficult lighting scenarios, and atmospheric conditions like fog/dust/haze and smoke. This paper also finds an approach to find the moving objects using the extended maxima algorithm and extraneous feature removal algorithm. This also directs a research towards object detection in foggy driving. In foggy weather contrast image enhancement and identifying the nearby objects is possible with image enhancement techniques. This helps the driver to avoid any accidents due to poor vision and thus to save human lives.

articleTitle: A Novel Park’s Vector Approach for Investigation of Incipient Stator Fault Using MCSA in Three-Phase Induction Motors
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Fault detection of induction motors at an early stage is a critical issue related to industrial maintenance. It is of utmost significance to a situation where in a sudden failure of induction motor may lead to shutdown of production practices and might result in the disruption of essential services such as medical, transportation or military. This further leads to huge economic losses and wastage of raw material. Several methods of fault detection have been proposed in literature, but the Motor Current Signature Analysis (MCSA) is the most reliable and widely used technique having advantage of noninvasiveness. The stator fault can be diagnosed at incipient stage during the time of Condition Monitoring (CM). This article presents a novel fault detection method using Park's Vector Approach (PVA) for Inter-Turn Short (ITS) fault in a squirrel cage induction motor by monitoring three phase stator current. The method transforms the three phase stator current into two orthogonal phases and then finds the fault based on the spatial variations of Parks current vector locus. Experimental results obtained from a healthy motor (without any turn fault), motor with 2.2%, 4% and 5.1% shorted turns are presented to validate the technique. The proposed technique not only detects the fault existence but also estimates the level of fault severity.

articleTitle: Harmonics Mitigation Of P&O MPPT Based Solar Powered Five-Level Diode-Clamped Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Recent advancement in modern technology has widely increased the expediency of power, which causes the broadening of conventional sources. So to meet the demand gleaning energy from renewable energy sources have become popular now-a-days. Solar photovoltaic (SPV) technology which converts solar radiation directly into the electrical energy is one of the good choices in renewable energy family. This paper presents a stand-alone SPV system in which designing and simulation of Boost converter connected with diode-clamped multilevel inverter for ac load is presented. Perturb and observe MPPT algorithm has been implemented to extract maximum power. The premier objective is to obtain voltage with less harmonic distortion. Multilevel inverter has changed the scenario in the utilization of renewable energy. Multi-carrier PWM techniques have been implemented and analyzed for modulation scheme. The proposed system is simulated on MATLAB/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: C band, X band and Ku band corner Arc Microstrip Patch Antenna with T-slot on Partial Ground Plane
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: In this paper, four corner arc microstrip patch antenna with T-slot on partial ground plane for application of C band, X band and Ku band has been proposed. By using partial ground we have found bandwidth from 3.68 GHz to 16.37 GHz. There is impedance matching between dielectric component and semi conducting at ground plane where T slot embedded is done. The length of patch has been taken 11.7mm and width is 18mm. The resonant frequency for which simulation has been done is 10GHz. In this proposed antenna design, we have used dielectric material RT durroid 5880 which have relative permeability is 2.2, thickness is 1.6mm and loss tangent is 0.0009. Moreover, corner arc with small circular cut on patch provided bandwidth of 12.69GHz. The radiation pattern is almost omnidirectional in the H-plane. The antenna design is simulated and analyzed at HFSS (high frequency structure simulator) software.

articleTitle: A High Linearity and Moderate Gain LNA for Receiver Front-End Applications in 2.4GHz ISM Band
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Using EDA tool for simulation and design of the low noise amplifier, the design and production of RF low noise amplifier has accelerated. LNA is designed using BSIM3 0.13μm technology for 2.4 GHz ISM band using ADS tool, based on cascode topology using feed forward cancellation (FDC) technique. To improve linearity, feed forward cancellation technique has been used. The desired LNA has excellent linearity, moderate gain and considerable matching of input impedance. The designed LNA is having S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>= -5.562 dB, S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub>=10.976 dB, NF=10.26 dB and IP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>=17.0 dBm.

articleTitle: Path tracking of differential drive mobile robot using two step feedback linearization based on backstepping
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: This Paper discusses Back-stepping based control strategy for path tracking of differential-drive mobile robot with nonholonomic constraints. In this Two step Feedback linearization control strategy is used to linearize kinematics and dynamics of the system. The Desired commands for linear velocity and heading angle direction are developed and by controlling the torque inputs, Mobile robot is made to track the path. Stability analysis based on Lyapunov function is made to bound the errors in position and heading angle. Simulation studies are performed with various reference trajectories to illustrate the effectiveness of developed controllers.

articleTitle: Comparative study of noise and digital filters for image processing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Filtering is most important and critical task to immaculate information like edge detection, object identification, brightness, contrast etc. from the noisy image. Various types of noises are due to faulty instrument, temperate rise of camera and some time added intentionally to preserve other useful information of the image and also depends on its transmission over various media like space to earth through vacuum media and Sea to earth station through water media etc. In this paper we presented essential used noises and filtering techniques and simulated in matlab. We discussed the noise effects and its corresponding filters. We also simulated and discussed best suitable filter to various type of noise and its results on standard image in matlab.

articleTitle: A review of various applications of low noise amplifier
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: LNA is a vital component in radio frequency communication systems. Various applications of low noise amplifier are reviewed in this paper. The design considerations for low noise amplifier are different for different applications. Comparative study of different applications of LNA has been done and reviewed in this paper.

articleTitle: IoT based smart campus
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: IoT based Smart surveillance system is designed with the help of Arduino UNO Board. Here we use wireless technology to give necessary security. The proposed system clicks images and sends it via GSM over the mobile network, which is accessed through SMS on the mobile device. Arduino controls an IP camera for surveillance that captures images when motion is detected by using PIR sensor and then sends these images to authorized person with the help of SMTP. Similarly, recording from multiple places will be collected and transmitted to authorized person over the mail via SMTP.

articleTitle: A review of low noise amplifier for 2.4GHz frequency band
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: This paper presents the review of design parameters and different topologies used for Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) in a particular frequency band i.e., 2.4 GHz, for RF wireless receiver. Low noise amplifier is the foremost component of radio frequency receiver system. The design for LNA basically depends upon a number of parameters. This paper will investigate the different topologies of LNA. These topologies are able to reduce power consumption in CMOS for 2.4GHz. Other characteristics like high gain, low noise, input matching, output matching, low noise figure and good third intercept point are also obtained via these topologies.

articleTitle: Enhancing User-Stories Prioritization Process in Agile Environment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Agile software development life cycle is mostly being used in the organizations to develop a high quality software system and it provides rapid delivery of the product to customer. In Agile environment, the requirements or features to be delivered are taken in the form of user-stories. The user-stories are to be prioritized for better quality and maintaining business value of the software in the market. The user-stories prioritization depends upon various factors like cost, time and resources etc. There are some methods that are used to prioritize user-stories but as per the literature review done, these methods are not efficient. In this research work, some factors are considered on the basis of which the agile user-stories are prioritized in agile environment. The proposed research work will help software organizations to enhance user-stories prioritization process.

articleTitle: Estimation of Monthly Rainfall using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Hydro-meteorological measures are one of the most challenging tasks of nature. Rainfall has become the most significant and technical factor for scheduling and functional criteria of any irrigation program with profound effects on agribusiness based economy for any region. It is vital important to accurately estimate rainfall and has been remained a great challenge. To estimate medium range monthly summer monsoon rainfall, machine learning models were developed using thirteen rain-gauges' long-term-average rainfall values of Jaipur city. The different input combinations of rain-gauges having 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and all-input parameters were explored using rainfall values of rain-gauge stations of Viratnagar, Bassi, Chaksu, Chomu, Jaipur, Dudu, Jamuna_Ramgarh, Kotputli, Phagi, Phulera, Amber, Sanganer, Shapura in Jaipur city. Exploring various empirical and dynamic machine learning approaches on rainfall data of 54 years period [1961-2015], rain-gauge station-wise were computed to evaluate the best rain-gauge station of Jaipur city with selection of best model for medium range estimation of monthly summer monsoon rainfall of Jaipur city. In the course of escalated experimentation, it is observed that Linear Regression outperforms over rest of other machine learning techniques and Amber rain-gauge station is the best rain-gauge among all used stations. The dataset utilized for this work is accessible as supplement at http://waterresources.rajasthan.gov.in authored by Government of Rajasthan.

articleTitle: Stabilization of Mobile Inverted Pendulum Using Fractional Order PID Controllers
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Mobile inverted pendulum (MIP) is a popular nonlinear robotic system used by researchers to perform control experiments. The MIP has two wheels to move and balance the pendulum. In this paper fractional order PID controllers have been used for the stabilization of MIP system. Fractional order PID controllers have been used to provide a robust design of the controllers for the stabilization of MIP system. A two loop control scheme has been used for stabilization of MIP system one controller is used for controlling the position of the MIP system and the other controller is used for controlling the pendulum angle of the system. The tuning of the fractional order PID controllers has been done using trial and error method. Simulation results obtained by both simple PID controllers and fractional order PID controllers are compared and it is shown that we get better response with fractional order PID controllers.

articleTitle: Smooth Starter for DC Shunt Motor using Buck-Boost Power Converter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: This Paper deals with a smooth dc motor starter using dc/dc buck-boost converter simulated using Matlab - SIMULINK. This type of converter is mainly used to regulate the desired output voltage level and maintain dc motor speed constant. The dc motor widely uses high precision digital controllers. The dc motor is a self-starting motor, having various starting methods. The main limitation of 4-point starter is that it has no control on the high speed of the motor. The field current automatically reduces to zero due to which the field winding of the motor gets opened under running condition, thus resulting in more power loss in the external resistance of the four point starter. These limitations are overcome by the present research work. The obtained results show that the starting current of dc shunt motor has been controlled with in the desired limit.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Gain Scheduled PID Controller for PWR type of Nuclear Reactor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: In this paper a strategy for an adaptive gain scheduled PID controller is proposed for PWR type of Nuclear reactor. Nuclear reactors are highly nonlinear in nature. The proportion of Pressurized Water Reactor is beyond 60% of the total Nuclear reactor components, since PWRs are the most desirable reactors for producing nuclear power. The reactor power level is regulated by adjusting the control rod speed. The reactor model is developed from the basic point-kinetics equations with reactivity feedback and thermal hydraulic considerations. The reactor model is linearized at different percentages of reactor power levels. There is a significant variation in linear model parameters and Gain scheduled adaptive PID control scheme is attempted to accommodate the variations in model parameters at different power levels. The performance of proposed controller is compared with fixed PID controller. From the results obtained it is found that the proposed control scheme gives an improved performance over conventional PID.

articleTitle: Analysis of Broken Rotor bar Fault Diagnosis for Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Induction motors are widely used motors in industrial applications. These are reliable and robust, however may develop a multitude of faults related to machine components like bearings, stator or rotor, etc. Consequently, a number of motor fault identification methods have been developed in the past years for their early diagnosis. This paper gives a comparative analysis for detection and diagnosis of broken rotor bar faults occurring in three phase induction motors fed through variable speed drive. Firstly, it gives a brief overview of two widely used methods known as Motor Current Signature Analysis (MCSA) and Park's Vector Analysis (PVA). Secondly, it provides the details of experimentation carried out to find the presence of broken rotor bar fault and judge their severity. Further, a comparative analysis of both methods is provided in finding the presence and judging the severity of broken rotor bars for motors operating under different loading conditions. PVA is used here successfully for experimentally determining fault severity. Motor parameters such as current, voltage and slip are used as diagnosis means for finding the presence of broken rotor bars and estimating their number. Since fault indicators in motor parameters are highly dependent on operating conditions, the data is acquired for different motor loading. The results obtained are compared and verified using both the methods.

articleTitle: Solid state transformer with a LC filter for distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: The concept of solid state transformer (SST) has become one of most emerging and focused topic in 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century as mentioned by Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) Technology review. With the increased in complexity and power demands we need to move towards new technology and SST is the only solution. If smart grid is the future of electrical power system then SST is the brain of this system. It would not only provide the efficient functioning as a conventional transformer but also provide other benefits, particularly on demand reactive power maintenance for the grid, good power quality, fault isolation and voltage conversion. In this paper, we are going to discuss the application and proposed topologies in distribution system.

articleTitle: Implementation of REST Architecture in ARDUINO Based Home Automation System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Internet of things (IOT) imagines a world where every device at any place can be connected. It creates a world where the lights can automatically turn on, door gets opened automatically on the arrival of the family member and remains locked when any stranger arrives, coffee automatically brews off when the morning alarm goes off and many more applications. Internet of things is not the internet but it could be called as the network of the devices which are connected to the internet. In this direction many research work is going on. In this paper we have proposed the details of how we can automate the home appliances using ARDUINO and REST architecture. The result also shows how the use of ARDUINO and REST architecture is beneficial as compared to other available resources in the field of Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Automation and Design of Real-Time Controllers for a Laboratory Scale Bioreactor
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Automation of any process improves process efficiency, yield and minimizes overall cost. Bioreactors place a significant role in pharmaceutical and food processing industries. To utilize the microbes efficiently, the bioreactor should provide optimum conditions such as temperature, pH, oxygen etc. The online monitoring of bioprocess is enhanced by online control of the essential parameters to improve product yield. The effective monitoring of bioprocess is necessary to develop, optimize and maintain biological reactors at maximum efficiency. Furthermore, due to the nature, type and volume of products produced in bioprocesses, there is a strong economic incentive for process monitoring to increase yield and productivity. Most of the bioreactors are supplied with Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)based automation.Most of the PLC supports only PID controllers. The novelty in this paper is the implementation of control algorithms for multiple parameters such as temperature, pH, antifoam and Dissolved Oxygen(DO) using Lab VIEW based automation. The interfacing was done via NI Compact DAQ. Lab VIEW based automation will enhance the performance of the bioreactor with advanced control schemes. The results show that the real-time automation strategy developed in Lab VIEW is capable of simultaneously controlling the temperature, pH, DO and antifoam.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Low Voltage Low Power Inverter Based Double Tail Comparator
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Today the demand of portable devices with low power consumption, efficient in operation and reduced noise are taking attentions to focus more towards the dynamic regenerative comparator. In this paper, an approach of double tail comparator with a technique of regenerative inverter is introduce which is importantly basic component of ADCs, the result is confirmed by the 180 nm CMOS Technology post layout simulation. The supply low voltage at 0.8V and sampling frequency GHz are taken under consideration.

articleTitle: Defected Ground Structure Based Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna With Triple Band Operation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: A simple defected ground microstrip patch antenna for three frequency bands is proposed. The novelty of the design leads to decrease in size of patch by using H-shaped DGS integrated with inverted L-DGS. Using this idea a three band patch antenna is designed that resonates at three frequencies 1.82, 2.4 and 5.52 GHz. Design and simulation of the proposed antenna is done using Computer Simulation Technology (CST) Microwave Studio 2012 Electromagnetic solver. Results obtained from CST reveal that the gain and return loss have almost doubled with previous reported results. Size of the main radiating element is also reduced by about 80.75 %. The bandwidth improvement in the proposed antenna is seen about 70.5%, 490.5 % and 377.25 % at 1.82, 2.4, 5.52 GHz respectively when compared with earlier reported results. The designed antenna can be used in communication applications involving IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n bands and GSM 1.8 GHz band.

articleTitle: Secure data transmission in cloud environment using visual cryptography and genetic algorithm: A review
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Now a day’s Cloud Computing is the great concept in the development of an on-demand network which provides access to a common pool of configurable resources that can be rapidly provisioned and released with minimal management effort or service provider interaction where Infrastructure, Platform, and Software can be accessed as a service.Cloud Computing provides reimbursement in terms of low cost and convenience of data, but its unique feature is its security. Sharing of data is an imperative functionality in cloud storage.In Cloud computing environment the sharing of data and transfer has increased exponentially. There are the various factors in data security like integrity, confidentiality, and authentication services. Maintaining secrecy and protection for critical data are highly challenging, particularly when data are stored in memory or send via any communication networks. I have reviewed several papers regarding our concept and what I found is that in some papers, GA has been used for security, In other papers used GA, VC, and Steganography together for enhancing security. But some are providing security quite well, having high overhead. And those which have low overhead, have poor security. In this paper we have described the genetic algorithm and visual cryptography related papers which helps to know the all areas where these techniques will be used. Genetic algorithm is used for providing encryption and decryption, for hiding critical data we are using visual cryptography

articleTitle: An Efficient Face Parts Detection Technique for CCTV Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: The use of Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) for surveillance is becoming useful day by day. Human face detection is one of the prime demand for intelligent CCTV systems. There are various application zones in which confront location can be connected. In the proposed method discovery of various facial parts, for example, Eye Pair, Nose and Mouth and can accomplish quick, exact recognition that is robust to changes in illumination as well as background. The results comes out show the significant performance improvement utilizing the proposed approach over the other former approaches. It can be seen that the proposed strategy is extremely proficient with noteworthy incentive in surveillance application.

articleTitle: Design of second order sliding mode controller for balancing of unicycle
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: A Unicycle robot based on a dynamic model is under study for balance and velocity control. Unicycle robot motion consists of roll and pitch axis control, roll axis motion is controlled by a reaction wheel and pitch axis motion is controlled by an in-wheel motor. There is no actuator for yaw axis control to make the dynamics simple. Dynamic equations are derived for the unicycle using the Euler-Lagrange equation to balance the unicycle and to obtain the dynamic speed control. Two separate sliding-mode controllers (SMC) are utilized to obtain roll axis balance along with pitch axis balance and velocity control respectively, their behaviour is studied and to avoid the chattering seen, a second order SMC (SOSMC) is proposed and implemented.

articleTitle: Comparison of Fuzzy Logic and PI Controlled SMES to Improve Load Fluctuations in Hybrid Power System
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: This paper gives an application of SMES to minimize fluctuations in load of a small scale hybrid power system consisting of a 400 KVA diesel generator. The Super conducting magnetic storage system consists of a thyristor bridge, a step down transformer and an inductor coil to smooth out fluctuations in the output power, load angle and minimize speed deviation. The angle at which the bridge converter of SMES is fired is controlled by PI controller. The simulation results of PI controlled and fuzzy controlled system are compared using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: SIW BasedSlot Antenna Array using Microstrip Feeding Technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: In this research paper, slot antenna array based on substrate integrated waveguide is proposed. Initially, we design 2*2 symmetric slot antenna array. This design is based on double substrate, 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> substrate is used to form SIW and 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> is kept as it is. A slot antenna placed on 1st substrate. A H shaped and four slots are cut on patch at centre of antenna. At both end of H slot, two metal vias are inserted. For enhancement in gain & bandwidth we design asymmetric type slot antenna array and finally 4*4 slot antenna array presented. Gain and bandwidth is achieved approx. 10.22 dB and 13.29 % respectively.

articleTitle: A review on security measures of Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Recently Cloud Computing has come into the view as a paradigm for hosting and delivering services over the internet. With the advancement of the technology, various companies especially the popular social networking sites like Facebook are adopting it for storage of their massive data. The hadoop platform of cloud computing processes large data sets hence security of these data sets is the need of the hour. Current hadoop system is facing some vulnerability like lack of strong authentication, no proper access control and so on. In this survey, the work done by various researchers in the field of cloud computing with particular emphasis on security parameter has been defined concisely. All of the researchers have described their own methods of providing security along with the drawbacks and future scope of the approach they have followed in their research. So, after going through some of the studies in this field, it is clear that some measures have to be proposed in order to overcome the security lacks associated with hadoop system so as to protect the confidential data of users from malicious attacks.

articleTitle: Identification of Optimal Alternative as a Prospective Candidate for Further Design Improvements using Preference Selection Index Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: In the modern era of advancements, the market is flooded with countless alternatives in order to offer a large number of options to their customers. This has led to an increase in the competition between major players in the market. To help stand stiffly in this ever-increasing competition, the manufacturers are required to select the model that best suits the customer requirement, and further add value to them. In this context, Multicriteria Decision making is a critical phase before any design and development stage. Different Multi Criteria Decision Making techniques are available to help decision makers in making a rational decision. The present paper seeks to select out the best model among eight randomly chosen Top Load Semi-Automatic Washing Machines with nearly same range of performance, using Preference Selection Index method. The method has been used because of its simplicity and an added advantage of non-requirement of relative importance between the decision attributes.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of solar PV fed UPQC with advanced MPPT technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Presently due to sudden growth in consumer load demand, penetration of Renewable energy sources (RES) has become a nice and interesting option. Among all RES a considerable growth is seen in photovoltaic system because of high availability of sun light and easy conversion. The involvement of photovoltaic with present distribution utility creates additional problem like nonlinearities, due to involvement of more and more power electronic equipment. With the rise in certain nonlinearities like voltage imbalance (voltage sag and swell), current distortions, power quality has become an important issue now. Different methodologies have been suggested in literature. A new approach is proposed in the present paper i.e combined UPQC-PV system. The UPQC basically consists of series active power filter in series and shunt active power filter in parallel to the distribution utility. The power circuit is supplied and regulated by PV. The series active filter based upon stationary d-q based theory deals with the distorted load end voltage and shunt active filter based upon instantaneous active power theory deals with the distorted source end current. Moreover an improved perturb and observe (P&O) based MPPT algorithm is incorporated with the PV boost converter for supplying switching pulse to improve performance of PV system. The PV system is directly connected to UPQC dc link via boost converter for optimal performance. The overall design of the proposed system is implemented in MATLAB Simulink software. The analysis of developed Simulink model provides further scope in advancement of combined UPQC-PV system.

articleTitle: Control of buck-boost converter using H∞ techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: This paper presents various robust H∞ control schemes for DC-DC buck-boost converter, such as H∞ loop shaping controller, GA based H∞ controller, LMI based robust H∞ controller and HIFOO based fixed order robust controller. These schemes are based on minimization of weighted sensitivity and complementary sensitivity functions. Detailed comparative analysis is done for the control of converter with MATLAB software. Also, robustness of the system is tested in presence of the external disturbances or system uncertainties.

articleTitle: Private Content-based Image Query System using Statistical Properties
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: The objective of this research work is to investigate whether content-based image retrieval system is able to respond accurately without knowing query. While using statistical properties for retrieving our query from the large database, we simultaneously try to satisfy the security problems of users. The contribution of content-based image query system to reduce human labour and time add great value to it. Privacy threats also arise in using content-based image query system because the sample of the query image is required to search the similar image from the database. This research proposes the encryption scheme that can be applied to the query images in order to preserve the privacy of the image content. Here we propose a framework for private content-based image query system that computes the statistical similarity between the image of interest and encrypted image.

articleTitle: A modified MPPT technique for drift reduction using neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: In this, the paper concerns about the drift analysis by acquiring different maximum power point tracking (MPPT) techniques, that is perturb and observe (P&O) and modified perturb and observe (P&O). By varying the values of few parameters with respect to the number of iterations performed for which mainly two type of controllers are been employed i.e. proportional integral controller (PI) and Neural network controller. With respect to the MPPT techniques is concerned, P&O algorithm is mainly chosen to be executed through MATLAB simulation for better results. For which PV/Solar panel is connected with SEPIC converter for exacting the input signal at the output along with drift observation. A modified P&O technique is designed to escape the drift problem by assimilating the maximum information of deviation of current I for determination process in accession with deviation in power P & deviation in voltage V. Finally this model is been implemented using MATLAB simulink tool in r2010a.

articleTitle: SWT-SIFT based copy-move forgery detection of digital images
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: By integrating Stationary wavelet transform (SWT) with conventional Scale Invariant Feature Transformation (SIFT) we are trying to increase the number of key points detected and matched in a digital image while the image is checked for being forged. With increased Key points we get a preferable match for the forged area in the digital image. We Collate the results of SWT based Approach with SIFT and SURF to peruse the key point based forgery Detection. When we affiliate Stationary Wavelet Transform (SWT) With SIFT the algorithm is adept to subdue the lack of translation invariance in discrete Wavelet transform (DWT).

articleTitle: Comparison of measures of collaborative filtering recommender systems: rating prediction accuracy versus usage prediction accuracy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Recommender Systems (RSs) help users to find items of their choices. There are many types of RSs that produce good recommendations for the user. Every system designer tries to choose the best RS for their application. There is a basic question after each recommendation computation. Is the recommended item liked by the user? The whole process to compute recommendation is meaningful, if the recommended items suit the choices of the user. The selection of best RS for an application is a bigger challenge for the system designer. RSs are compared on their evaluation matrices. This paper compares the evaluation measures for collaborative filtering RSs. The accuracy measures are Measuring Ratings Predicting Accuracy (MRPA) and Measuring Usage Prediction Accuracy (MUPA). Furthermore, the advantage and disadvantage of both accuracy measures are also examined through an experiment. The machine learning libraries of Mahout is used for the setup of an experiment. The experiment is conducted with the MovieLense dataset.

articleTitle: Simulation of bi-layer organic polymer light emitting diode using LiF/Al cathode
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Nowadays device development using organic diodes (OLEDs) is kicking out inorganic diodes as they are more economical, flexible, faster and have higher luminosity than the inorganic devices. This paper presents the results of bi-layer organic polymer simulation with LiF/Al as the cathode and ITO as anode. Silvaco Atlas TCAD tool is used for simulation and analysis of the OLED device. The electrical and optical characteristics of OLEDs like I-V characteristics, recombination rate, exciton density, transient time versus anode current, transient time versus exciton density etc are presented. Simulation is based on distribution of Langevin recombination model. The model presented here will be helpful in future for the optimization of better electrical parameters.

articleTitle: Optimized Circular Coil Based Deperming Protocol of Naval Vessels Using Cage Systems
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Naval vessels are made up offerromagnetic material which acquire permanent magnetism under the influence of the external applied magnetic field as well as earth's magnetic field. Deperming process is used to reduce the permanent magnetism in which objects are subjected to strong alternating decaying magnetic field. In traditional method, the entire vessel is tightly wrapped with coil in helical form. However, this method is constrained with geometrical impediments, number of windings and time consuming due to wrapping and unwrapping of individual vessel. In this paper, a deperming protocol with optimized solenoid and four circular coil cage systemsis proposed and comparative analysis is carried out. Experimental results show 99.91% homogeneity with greater accessibility of object and lesser number of windings as compared to wrapping based system. A deperming cage with feasible dimensions is designed and simulations are carried out with plausible choice of parameters. The analysis is based on finite element method having trajectory following hysteretic model which is used to showcase the effect of different cage systems.

articleTitle: Design of an Adaptive LMS Second Order Volterra Series Filter for Removing Noise from Vibration Signal of Faulty Bearing
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: This paper proposes designing and application of Adaptive Second Order Volterra Series Filter for reducing noise from nonlinear system. Based on the lattice-channel structure with delayed element the Adaptive Second Order Volterra Series Filter with Least Mean Square (ASVSF-LMS) algorithms have been derived to remove noise from vibration signal of Faulty Bearing in AC motor system, In order to reduce the computational complexity and the nonlinear distortion with no need of solving the lengthy nonlinear acoustic equation, the ASVSF-LMS algorithm with a lattice structure and least means square algorithm is proposed. MATLAB simulations demonstrate the control and error performance improvement using the proposed algorithms.

Author Keywords: Band Limit White Noise Generator and Hardware setup of AC Motor for Vibration Signal of Faulty Bearing

articleTitle: Integration of robotics components and verification using petri net
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: We advocate developing new components by using already developed components thus reduces time and effort of development. The issues of concurrency, compatibility, correctness, coordination arises during component composition while using synchronous or asynchronous communication. We were motivated with MARIE[17] an integration effort which has shortcomings of tight coupling and multithreaded request/response architecture produces non deterministic behavior of execution. We selected components Player/Stage [18] (A network server for robotics), Wall Follower Service, Wanderer available in field of robotics and tried to verify the component composition before developing an integration platform. For verification purpose we decided to use model checking instead of theorem proving. We used Petri net [19], a language of concurrent system and petri net tool PIPE for preparing the model of composition. Since the components communicate using their interfaces so we established theory of interface, component and their interface composition. Finally we came to a conclusion based on the composed petri net model that issues of deadlock can only be removed by using implicit synchronization in a concurrent system.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach with Zero Mean Distribution and Randomization for Privacy Preservation Technique
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Currently increasing in data exhaustive processing systems of information is now becomes very important for making decisions in the business or companies. Important and responsive knowledgeable designs may consist in process of the business analysis. Now a day privacy-preserving data-mining may obtain a huge enhancement with the help of data-mining and the researchers of the Information security community in the development of the technologies that are merges with the concerns of privacy. In the original data, the random-noise is added in the privacy preserving data Mining (PPDM) method, that is used for publishing the exact information regarding the actual data. The basic perspective of the privacy preserving data mining is to design various algorithms for updating the actual data and for providing the security to the information which is to be get misused, as a result of this the private data and private information still remain same even after the mining process. This paper calculates the results on comparative dependent analytical of the privacy preserving data mining algorithms and implemented those in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Power Factor Improvement by using Artificial Neural Network with Single Inductor Dual Output circuit implementation
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Today latest technologies have been used to reduce the losses of the existing system and slow down the rate of occurrence of global warming. Most of the designs and researches aim to improve the power quality of the system. Purpose to design this circuit for the power factor improvement single inductor dual output circuit used single source in input side with the dual or multiple output system. Now days the consumers uses electronic equipments in large amount that shows utilization of maximum or multiple output through the minimum input source. In this the PI controller circuit is reconstructed with the help of Artificial Neural Network as a controller with fly-back converter. The design also shows the comparison between the both (PI & ANN) controllers. Through output gives the regulated output supply, here this study about the artificial neural network is efficiently remove problems to improve the power factor and reduce more THD (i.e. total harmonic distortion). The Artificial neural network helps oscillation, overshooting and undershooting and provides light weight, less settling time, small size. Main purpose to design this circuit improving the power factor with ANN controller MATLAB simulation is used to design the circuit. This design is shows that the ANN controller is more accurate when compared to the conventional system.

articleTitle: Multi-hopped Aggressive Packet Combining Scheme
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Error in the wireless channel is a great challenge for researchers. While transmission of packet through wireless channel the reception of erroneous packet at the receiver end is the common phenomenon. Every time when a packet is received by receiver an acknowledgment is sent by receiver in order to provide information about reception through Automatic repeat request (ARQ). A method of getting correct packet from erroneous packet in back error correction technique is Aggressive Packet Combining scheme (APC). In this paper a new method Multi-hopped Aggressive Packet Combing (MHPC) scheme for back error correcting technique has been proposed through back error correcting technique. Mathematical analysis is made for the scheme.

articleTitle: A novel compact broadband microstrip fed antenna with wide axial ratio bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: In this article, a circularly polarized compact size wide slot monopole design consisting of microstrip feed line and a circular stub protruded in ground plane in the direction of -x axis is presented. The radius and position of circular shaped stub are optimized to get desirable circular polarization bandwidth. The antenna design proposed has -10 dB bandwidth of 107.6% (3.3-11 GHz) and a wide axial ratio bandwidth of 61.66% (4.06-7.68 GHz). The antenna prototype is designed on FR4 substrate of dimension 20×20×1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: A Comparison Study of Signal Processing Tools for Denoising of Electrocardiogram Signal
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) signal is a nonstationary signal which shows the electrical action of the human heart and detects the cardiac abnormalities generated in the heart. But usually this signal is contaminated with different types of noises like baseline wander, power line interference, electromyography noise etc. After contamination the waveform of the signal get corrupted which shows incorrect detection of noises. Here, different types of methodologies like FIR windowing techniques, adaptive filters and wavelet based filter are used for denoising the noisy ECG signal. For analysis of performance estimation different parameters like Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR), Mean Square Error (MSE) and Percent of Root mean square Difference (PRD) are calculated and compared. The simulation results show that wavelet method is better among all these methods.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Information Retrieval System for Finding Contextual Information on Twitter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Today lot of rich & opinionated data is available on social micro blogging websites like Twitter. Though the data plays an integral role of contemplating the behavior of the crowd much of it is scattered. The underlying model is an attempt to retrieve information from this data and consequently discover knowledge in the context of the user based on his/her comments about a trending event or hash-tag. The proposed model uses basic mining approaches like keyword-extraction, ranking of tweets and summarization of data to meet the objective. The work has been empirically tested for seven hash-tags and an average precision of 0.514 was attained.

articleTitle: Security Threats and Challenges on Different Protocol Layers in Cognitive Radio Networks: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: In the past decade, there has been a rapid development of new technologies in wireless communication which has led an increased demand for radio spectrum. The radio spectrum needs to be utilized effectively because of the fixed assignment policy of the spectrum a large part of the licensed spectrum remains under-utilized. This is leading to the concept of the strategic use of these bands by so called, Cognitive Radio (CR) and CR Networks (CRN). CR is a revolutionary technology which allows the unlicensed user to co-exist along with licensed user. It complements the wireless device by helping in improving its efficiency, reliability, and speed. New security threats have being lifted along with the understanding of cognitive radio, which thereby degrades the performance of cognitive radio. Because of the wireless nature of CRNs, they face all kinds of threat possible in traditional wireless networks. The main objective of this work is to sum up all possible security threats and challenges on different protocol layers in CRN.

articleTitle: Energy Aware AODV Routing Protocol for Critical Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Adhoc network has mobile nodes which are moving in this network without any centralized control. Because of that multi-hop topology may change very frequently. Nodes in Mobile ADHOC networks, has finite energy, and it is practically infeasible to schedule shortest path route because of the batter discharge and maintenance of these nodes. This issue has been addressed in this paper because of in certain critical applications of Ad-Hoc Network like war planning or Emergency handling mobility should be free from path breakages and packet loss. Optimal use of energy in the participating nodes, is increasingly becoming matter of importance. In this paper, In this paper authors have implemented an Energy-Aware AODV Routing Protocol (EA-AODVRP) to minimize the energy consumption also This system proposes hat instead of the shortest path the network route should be planned with nodes with maximum energy.

articleTitle: Realization of fractional order dual-band microwave filter
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: In this paper, an existing fractional-order microwave filter realization technique is generalized for improving the magnitude response of any microwave filter either single band or multi-band. This generalization is based on the behavioral analysis of individual lumped element over dominating frequencies. Further, the proposed technique is used to enhance the performance of dual-band microwave filter. Results of the newly designed filter are compared with the existing dual-band filter to see the efficacy of proposed technique.

articleTitle: A Survey of Energy Harvesting Technologies
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Several different ambient energy sources available like ocean waves, thermoelectricity, piezoelectricity and physical motions. The energy harvesting from these sources are applicable to WSNs and portable electronic equipment. This paper review about energy harvesting technologies their significance and limitations.

articleTitle: Cost Optimization with Electric Vehicles and Renewable Energy Sources using Priority List Method
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Emission from coal fired power plants and internal combustion engine vehicles are the main sources of green-house gas emission. This is one of the reason which results in the increased usage of renewable energy power plants for power generation and electric vehicles (EVs) for the transportation. Modern grid comprises of renewable energy sources such as wind and solar power plants along with conventional generators. But the stochastic behavior of solar and wind power plants result in intermittent output by these generators. Hence to compensate the effect of the fluctuation and random behavior, use of electric vehicles is being proposed. Electric vehicles act as loads and get charged at the time of surplus power and when there is deficit of power, EVs can discharge power stored in them to the grid. The problem of unit commitment has been solved by priority list method using Mipower considering conventional power plants, electric vehicles and renewable energy sources. The proposed strategy reduces the operation cost and greenhouse gas emission in presence of wind and solar powers in a micro grid. Plug-in electric vehicles have many capabilities but load curve modification has been emphasized. The main aim for doing such scheduling is to reduce not only the operation cost but also the emission by the conventional generator and by the Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) vehicles. The proposed method utilizes priority list method to solve unit commitment for cost optimization keeping in view the different constraints imposed by the real time power system. The study is carried on Mipower version 9 software.

articleTitle: MGWO Meta Heuristic Algorithm vs. Classical Tuning Method of FOPID Controller for Inverted Pendulum
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Recent studies show that fractional order proportional integral derivative (FOPID) controller showing better performance than PID. This paper deals with the study of FOPID controller for inverted pendulum system and comparison between them. The first method used here is traditional tuning of FOPID controller parameter and the second method is recently developed heuristic method i.e. Modified Grey Wolf Optimization (MGWO) tuning method of FOPID controller. After fine tuning of both controller parameter comparisons between both performances are compared. After comparison, it is shown that recently developed optimization technology i.e. MGWO has better performance.

articleTitle: Controlling Multi Thread Execution using Single Thread Event Loop
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Programming language of today does not have concurrency semantics and the only way of developing concurrency is to use multithread based request/response architecture. This model of concurrency produces non deterministic nature of execution and leads issues of deadlock, race conditions and synchronization further leads problem of managing locks. We decided to use single threaded non blocking asynchronous communication as used in Node.js[1]. Actor[2][3][4] model uses non blocking asynchronous communication and event loop ensures single threaded model of control of execution to process one message at a time. Actors communicate by communication passing style using callback ( a mechanism of using function inside a function) has issues of Inversion of control or callback hell. So we decided to use Promise[5] a monad[6][7] as a return type of asynchronous communication. All the concurrent execution models Erlang[8], Salsa[9], Scala[10] developed in past supports thread based deployment model and does not abstract invocation from execution[8]. We support design by contract or programming through interfaces by developing a promise based concurrent abstraction framework. Using this abstraction we successfully integrated the components and designed the application of robotics subsumption model. Finally we concluded that promise based asynchronous communication is faster and takes less time than synchronous and callback based asynchronous communication.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation of Technology Acceptance Model of using C2C Mobile Business Application in Oman
publicationTitle: 2017 International Conference on Innovations in Control, Communication and Information Systems (ICICCI)
abstract: Customer-to-Customer (C2C) e-business is a technology that provides services where the customer can sell and buy from another customer. The organizations presenting Customer-to-Customer on-line offerings don't have a proper understanding and knowledge of the Customer-to-Customer exchange conduct and are unable to offer satisfied and effective layout for an internet C2C mobile application. The purpose this study is to investigate the acceptance of the particular business application by the users. The questionnaire has been created by using Google forms and distributed electronically through mail, and other social networking sites. The research is based on the theory of Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and its extensions. The study was conducted in Muscat, Sultanate of Oman. The questionnaire contains 19 survey questions and 7 demographic statements. Data were collected from 218 respondents belongs to various nationalities in which 210 are the valid responses. The structural equation modeling (SEM) method become used to assess the causal model and to look at the reliability and validity of the measurement model. The variables used in this study are perceived quality, perceived convenience, perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, perceived enjoyment and intention to use. The eight hypotheses have been tested. The implications of the research have also been discussed. The dataset used for the research is male-dominated and young users of the smartphones that deprive us to make the generalization.
